about_the_game:
Join your friends in this uniquely styled 2D cooperative party game, where communication, coordination, and a touch of chaos are the keys to achieving the highest score!

Step into the shoes of an employee of an interplanetary repair company and travel through unknown dimensions to fix damaged machines, keep everything running, and prove that your team is the most efficient in the universe.

Journey

In every mission, you’ll travel to new destinations with new machines to repair.

Gameplay

The game blends management, action, and mini-games in fast-paced levels:

  • Get ready for work: grab your tools — screwdriver, hammer, and wrench — and head out with your friends.

  • Repair machines through unique mini-games: each tool comes with a different challenge.

  • Watch out for mistakes: every error resets your multiplier! And if you waste time, the multiplier drops on its own.

  • Manage heat and pressure: as the heat rises, machines break down faster. Points increase, but so do mistakes! Pressure creates environmental hazards that can only be handled through valves — but be careful: lowering pressure also reduces heat.

Cooperation

The heart of the game is teamwork:

  • Communicate with your friends using funny emotes during moments of panic.

  • Pass and throw tools to speed up repairs and earn extra points.

  • Expect chaos, laughter, and the occasional friendly argument.

  • Aim high: climb the leaderboards and prove your team is the best!

If you’re looking for a game that tests your reflexes, coordination, and—most importantly—your friendship… you’ve come to the right place!
